lines.dialogue: You're late.
It's wonderful to see you, Gandalf!
What news of the outside world? Tell me everything!
You know Bilbo...he's got he whole place in an uproar.
Half the Shire's been invited...
He's up to something.
Alright then..keep your secrets. Before you came along we Bagginses were very well thought of.
Never had any adventures or did anything unexpected.
Whatever you did...you've been officially labelled as a Disturber of the Peace.
Gandalf... I'm glad you're back. Frodo leaps expertly from the cart. Gandalf smiles.
Go on, Sam, ask Rosie for a dance.
Oh, no you don't. Go on.
Bilbo! Watch out for the dragon!!
Speech!

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Bilbo! Bilbo!

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: He's gone, hasn't he? Frodo steps into the living room.

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: He talked for so long about leaving...I didn't think he'd really do it.

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Gandalf?

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Where are you going?

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: What things?

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: You've only just arrived! I don't understand...

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: What are you doing?

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Nothing...there's nothing. Wait...
Bilbo found it...in Gollom's cave.
But he was destroyed...Sauron was destroyed.
Alright!

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: We put it away, we keep it hidden! We never speak of it again. No one know it's here, do they? Gandalf shifts uncomfortably.

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Do they, Gandalf?

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Shire! Baggins! That will lead them here!

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Take it! Take it!

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: You must take it.

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: I'm giving it to you!

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: But it cannot stay in the Shire!

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: What must I do?
Where? Where shall I go?
Bree? What about you?
And the ring will be safe there?

lines.scene: INT. BAG END LIVING ROOM -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: I can cut across country easily enough.
This is what?
Come on, Sam.
Remember what Bilbo used to say...it's a dangerous business...
What are you talking about?
What did he say?
Sam...we're still in the Shire...what could possibly happen?
I think we should get off the road.
Get off the road!
Nothing.
I have to leave the Shire...Sam and I must get to Bree.
How far to the nearest crossing?
Come on.
We're headed for the prancing pony.
We wish to stay at the inn...our business is our own. To Frodo's relief, the Gatekeeper unlocks the gate.
Excuse me.
Underhill...my name's Underbill.
We're friends of Gandalf the Grey...can you tell him we've arrived? BUTTERBUR frowns...
Sam, he'll be here. He'll come.
Excuse me, that man in the corner, who is he?
Strider.
Pippin!

lines.scene: INT. HOBBIT'S ROOM, PRANCING PONY -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: What do you want?

lines.scene: INT. HOBBIT'S ROOM, PRANCING PONY -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: I carry nothing.

lines.scene: INT. HOBBIT'S ROOM, PRANCING PONY -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Who are you?

lines.scene: INT. HOBBIT'S ROOM, PRANCING PONY -- NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Yes.
Where are they?
Where are you taking us?
We have no choice but to trust him.
What are you doing?
Put it out, you fools! Put it out! Frodo desperately kicks dirt on the fire!
Go! !
Gandalf...Gandalf?
Where am I?
Gandalf!
What happened, Gandalf? Why didn't you meet us?
Gandalf! What is it? Gandalf returns his attention to Frodo.
Bilbo!
Bilbo!
"There and back again: A Hobbit's tale" by Bilbo Baggins.
This is wonderful.

I miss the Shire...I spent all my childhood pretending I was off somewhere else...off with you, on one of your adventures... But my own adventure, turned out to be quite different...I'm not like you, Bilbo.
Packed already?
I thought you wanted to see the Elves, Sam?
More than anything.
You're right, Sam. Frodo looks at Sam...
...we did what we set out to do. Frodo opens his hand, the Ring sits in his Palm.
The ring will be safe in Rivendell. I am ready to go home.
I will take it...I will take it...I will take the Ring to Mordor.
Though...I do not know the way. Gandalf rises to his feet.
It's so light!
We will go through the mines. Gandalf slowly nods.
It's a riddle...
Speak, friend, and enter. What's the Elvish for friend?
Gollum!
He escaped the dungeons of Barad- dur?
It's a pity Bilbo didn't kill him when he had the chance.
I wish the ring had never come to me...I wish none of this had happened.
Aragorn! Aragorn!
I'm alright. I'm not hurt.

lines.scene: INT. BRIDGE OF KHAZAD-DUM, MORIA -- DAY
lines.dialogue: Gandalf!

lines.scene: INT. BRIDGE OF KHAZAD-DUM, MORIA -- DAY
lines.dialogue: Gandalf!

lines.scene: INT. BRIDGE OF KHAZAD-DUM, MORIA -- DAY
lines.dialogue: No!
What will I see?
Gandalf!
If you ask it of me, I will give you the One Ring.
I cannot do this alone...
Then I know what I must do. It's just...I'm afraid to do it. Galadriel kneels down to Frodo's height, staring at him intently.

lines.scene: EXT. SLOPES OF AMON HEN -- DAY
lines.dialogue: I know what you would say, and it would seem like wisdom but for the warning of my heart.

lines.scene: EXT. SLOPES OF AMON HEN -- DAY
lines.dialogue: There is no other way.

lines.scene: EXT. SLOPES OF AMON HEN -- DAY
lines.dialogue: No. . .

lines.scene: EXT. SLOPES OF AMON HEN -- DAY
lines.dialogue: You are not yourself.

lines.scene: EXT. SUMMIT OF AMON HEN -- DAY
lines.dialogue: It has taken Boromir. ARAGORN moves towards Frodo...

lines.scene: EXT. SUMMIT OF AMON HEN -- DAY
lines.dialogue: Stay away!

lines.scene: EXT. SUMMIT OF AMON HEN -- DAY
lines.dialogue: Can you protect me from yourself?

lines.scene: EXT. SUMMIT OF AMON HEN -- DAY
lines.dialogue: Would you destroy it?

lines.scene: EXT. SUMMIT OF AMON HEN -- DAY
lines.dialogue: I know...Look after the others, especially Sam...he will not understand.

lines.scene: EXT. SHORE OF NEN HITHOEL -- DAY
lines.dialogue: I wish the ring had never come to me..I wish none of this had happened...

lines.scene: EXT. SHORE OF NEN HITHOEL -- DAY
lines.dialogue: No, Sam.

lines.scene: EXT. SHORE OF NEN HITHOEL -- DAY
lines.dialogue: Go back,Sam. I'm going to Mordor alone.

lines.scene: EXT. SHORE OF NEN HITHOEL -- DAY
lines.dialogue: You can't swim.

lines.scene: EXT. SHORE OF NEN HITHOEL -- DAY
lines.dialogue: Sam!

lines.scene: EXT. SHORE OF NEN HITHOEL -- DAY
lines.dialogue: Oh, Sam!

lines.scene: EXT. SHORE OF NEN HITHOEL -- DAY
lines.dialogue: Come on then..
Mordor! I hope the others find a safer road.
I don't suppose we'll ever see them again.
Sam?
I'm glad you're with me.

lines.scene: EXT. CULVERT, VALE OF MORGUL - DAWN
lines.dialogue: No . . . no it isn't. It isn't midday yet. The days are growing darker.

lines.scene: EXT. CULVERT, VALE OF MORGUL - DAWN
lines.dialogue: What about you?

lines.scene: EXT. CULVERT, VALE OF MORGUL - DAWN
lines.dialogue: Sam.

lines.scene: EXT. CULVERT, VALE OF MORGUL - DAWN
lines.dialogue: For what?
No, Sam! Leave him alone!
Sm. . . a
Sam! If you scare him off, we're lost.
I'm not sending him away.
We can't do this by ourselves, Sam. Not without a guide. I need you on my side.
I know, Sam, I know. You must trust me.
They're calling me!
What? That's all we have left!
He doesn't eat it . . . he can't have taken it.
Sam! Stop it!
No, Sam!
I ' m alright.
Get away!
No, Sam . . . it's you.
You can't help me anymore.
Go home.
Gandalf!
Gandalf!
Noooooooooooooooo!!!!
[Calls after Gandalf as he falls into the abyss] Gaaandaaaaalf!!
Gandalf!
Nothing. Just a dream. [Lies back down.]
He didnt mean for a lot of things to happen, Sam... but they did.
Its getting heavier. [Clutches the Ring by his chest and sits down, still panting. He then fumbles for his water bottle and takes a sip.]
What food have we got left?
[smiles] Nothing ever dampens your spirits, does it Sam?
[Exasperated] Its because weve been here before! Were going in circles.
Yes. I can smell it. [Drops to a whisper] Were not alone.
[menacingly] This is Sting. Youve seen it before, havent you... Gollum! Release him or Ill cut your throat!
Maybe he does deserve to die, but now that I see him, I do pity him.
Theres no promise you can make that I can trust.
The Ring is treacherous. It will hold you to your word.
Sam!
You know the way to Mordor?
Youve been there before?
You will lead us to the Black Gate.
[Looks at Gollum in perplexed gratitude and disbelief.] Gollum...
What did you say?
[Moves over and crouches in front of Gollum] Who are you?
Gandalf told me you were one of the River Folk.
He said your life was a sad story.
You were not so very different from a hobbit once, were you... Sméagol?
That was your name once, wasnt it? A long time ago.
Argh!
Argh!!
I did.
Sam, no!
I do not ask you to come with me, Sam.
Now!
Are you saying theres another way into Mordor?
Hes led us this far, Sam.
Hes been true to his word.
Lead the way, Sméagol.
Why do you do that?
Call him names; run him down all the time.
[Glaring at Sam] You have no idea what it did to him. What its still doing to him. [He walks past Sam and stops.] I want to help him, Sam...
Because I have to believe he can come back.
[Snapping at Sam]What do you know about it? Nothing!
[With remorse] I'm sorry, Sam. I don't know why I said that.
[Grows angry again] I know what I have to do Sam. The Ring was entrusted to me! It's my task! Mine! My own! [He walks away]
Weve got to get moving. Come on, Sam.
[Looking around] Sméagol?
Weve lingered here too long. Come on, Sam!
We are hobbits of the Shire. Frodo Baggins is my name and this is Samwise Gamgee.
[The merest hesitation.] There was no other.
We set out from Rivendell with seven companions. One we lost in Mória. Two were my kin. A Dwarf there was also, and an Elf. And two men, Aragorn, son of Arathorn, and Boromir of Gondor.
Yes... for my part.
[Shocked] Dead? How? When?
Wait! [Faramir stops] This creature is bound to me. And I to him. He is our guide. Please, let me go down to him.
Sméagol. [Gollum turns round at Frodos voice.] Master is here. Come, Sméagol. Trust master. Come!
Sméagol, you must trust master. Follow me, come on. Come. Come, Sméagol. Nice Sméagol. Thats it. Come on.
Dont hurt him! Sméagol dont struggle! Sméagol listen to me!
I cant. You were right, Sam. You tried to tell me, but Im sorry. The Rings taking me Sam. If I put it on, hell find me. Hell see.
No!! [He runs away from Faramir]
[With tears in his eyes] The Ring will not save Gondor. It has only the power to destroy. Please, let me go.
Faramir, you must let me go!
Its calling to him, Sam. His eye is almost on me.
[In a faraway voice] Theyre here. Theyve come.
Aaarrgghh!!!
[Slowly and with despair] I cant do this, Sam.
What are we holding on to, Sam?
What?
Huh, you left out one of the chief characters  Samwise the Brave. I want to hear more about Sam.
Frodo wouldnt have got far without Sam.
[smiling] So was I. [He turns to walk on]
Sméagol!
Sméagol?
